أَسْعَفُ A camel having the disease termed سَعَفٌ (see 1): fem. سَعْفَآءُ, applied to a she-camel: (ISk, S, K:) A'Obeyd mentions only the fem. epithet. (TA.) ―
-b2- Also A horse white, (S, * K,) or hoary, (S,) in the forelock, (S, K,) when there is some other colour in it, different from the white: (TA:) when the whole of it is white, he is termed أَصْبَغُ: (S, TA:) so in the “ Book of Horses ” by AO. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
